events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road' was originally released in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: That zebra crossing. That album. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' was released this month in '69. What's your favourite track from this masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to Chrissie Hynde, the legendary lead singer of The Pretenders, born in Akron, Ohio on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Pretenders Frontwoman
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude with The Pretenders defined an era. What's your top Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the unmistakable voice of Oasis and a successful solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday today, born September 21, 1972, in Manchester.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track from the main man?

events.title: Imagine Single Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's powerful single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on October 24, 1975, as part of his 'Shaved Fish' compilation.

angles.name: A Song of Hope
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' single was released in the UK. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: First iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the revolutionary first iPod on October 23, 2001, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? Twenty-five years ago this month, Apple launched the device that put '1,000 songs in your pocket' and changed how we listen to music forever. What was on your first iPod?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 'Dr. No' premiered, kicking off one of cinema's most iconic franchises. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today. The Beatles co-founder was born in Liverpool on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: John Lennon would have been 86 today. A true visionary whose music continues to inspire generations. What's the John Lennon song that resonates most with you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary British comedian and actor, John Cleese, born October 27, 1939, in Weston-super-Mare.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, John Cleese has given us some of the most iconic moments in British comedy. Happy 87th birthday to a true legend!

events.title: The White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was originally released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Diverse Masterpiece
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago this month, The Beatles delivered their sprawling, diverse masterpiece: 'The White Album'. A double album packed with classics. What's your standout track?

events.title: Freddie Mercury Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the phenomenal Freddie Mercury, who passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45. He would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Legendary Performer
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and legacy are truly immortal. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul' was released in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Pivotal Beatles Album
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul', an album that marked a significant shift in their sound. What's your standout track from this classic?
